name: Yoked
overview: The biblical concept of being 'yoked' highlights the importance of unity and harmony in relationships and obedience to God's commands. Scriptures such as Deuteronomy 22:10 and Leviticus 19:19 prohibit mismatched pairings, emphasizing that oxen or animals should not be yoked together if they are different types, symbolizing the need for compatibility. Jesus invites believers to take His yoke upon themselves, promising rest for their souls (Matthew 11:29), contrasting the yoke of bondage from which Christ frees us (Galatians 5:1). Bearing the yoke in youth (Lamentations 3:27) and walking worthy of the calling (Ephesians 4:1) further illustrate the Christian life involves willingly submitting to God's guidance in a way that reflects spiritual unity and strength.
